The vectors $v$ and $Av$ are shown above. If $A$ is a rotation-scaling matrix, then $A=$
worked_solution:
Since $A$ is a rotation-scaling matrix, then we can write

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}r & 0 \\ 0 & r\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  & -\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta  \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡\theta  & \operatorname{cos}⁡\theta \end{aligned}],
$$

where $r$ is the scale factor and $\theta $ the angle of rotation. 

According to the diagram, $r=3$ and $\theta =\frac{\pi }{2}.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}r & 0 \\ 0 & r\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  & -\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta  \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡\theta  & \operatorname{cos}⁡\theta \end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 0 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 & -1 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 & -3 \\ 3 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
